results.title: [Hiring] Video editor for construction company short-form content (Reels/TikTok/X), $25–40 per video, Remote
results.description:
We're iFixit General Contractor, a family-owned remodeling and home repair company in Langhorne, PA. We film a lot on the job: before-and-afters, carpentry close-ups, and quick trade tips that explain the "why" behind a technique. Our best tip video got 13K+ views, and we want more like it, consistently.

Pay: $25–40 per finished video, depending on length and experience
